purpose: One fixed, falsifiable residual student experiment; no Android model adoption or release dependency.

training.labels: Existing automatic pypinyin weak supervision, not reviewed gold
training.isolation: Verify full train/dev/test source-group separation. Remove exact/substring or <=1 edit sentence overlap with all declared evaluation inputs, before candidate export. Preserve attribution. No replacement sampling.
training.export: Current M19 actual-path-v1, sampled whole/midpoint, production LM/weights, empty personalization; independently audit every actual score component.
training.teacher: Pinned E38 Google Chinese BERT, qualified again before train scores; unchanged character PLL. Only eligible train groups whose reference is recalled in eligible slots provide supervision.
training.loss: 0.75 gold cross entropy + 0.25 T^2 KL(teacher PLL/T || student total/T), mean over groups
training.checkpoint: Final epoch only; no dev checkpoint selection, restart seed sweep, or hyperparameter search

student.architecture: Pretrained BertModel encoder without pooler/MLM head; concatenate CLS with 16 actual path features plus source prior, scaled /32 and clipped [-4,4]; new zero-initialized scalar linear head
student.scoring: original total + 8*tanh(new head/8). Stable ties preserve original order. Zero head exactly reproduces baseline. One encoder forward per candidate, all candidates batched.
student.inputs: [CLS] 0..2 left Han context + candidate [SEP]; no expected text, reference rank or teacher score at inference
student.eligibility: E38 first-8 same-length Han slots, length 2..24. Entire row falls back for unknown characters, missing features, nonfinite scores, or any selected source other than BASE_EXACT/BASE_COMPOSED. This excludes personal/correction overrides.
student.runtime: CPU float32 eager, 2 intraop/1 interop, deterministic training seed, no query cache

developmentGate: Each domain top1/top5 nondecreasing, recall unchanged, character errors nonincreasing; combined top1 strictly improves. Compare same current-production E36 streams. No new blind-data claim.
costGate: Warm extra host P95 <=100ms. Passing host timing is not Android eligibility.
stopRule: Failure of development stops this fixed student trial. Preserve losses and full evidence; do not run old test accuracy or Android integration merely to seek a pass. If it passes, separate old regression/device/lifecycle gates remain mandatory.
release: rc.4 and production sources/assets remain unchanged; public training data stays local, no real user input sent to a teacher service.
